resources.string: No overheating: never above %1$s °C for longer than 30 s.
No voltage readings with the engine running (PID 01.42 or adapter voltage).
The voltage was measured by the adapter at the OBD port — it can read 0.2–0.3 V lower than at the battery terminals: check with a multimeter.
The alternator is charging: never below %1$s V for longer than a minute.
